block.title: Policy Enforcement
block.help: What happens when an application breaks one of the rules below. The rules stay where they are; this only changes their consequence.

setting.help: Enforce refuses the application. Advise accepts it and records every rule it fails on the loan, so HR sees them and decides. Off does not evaluate the rules at all.

block.title: Eligibility
block.help: Who may borrow, and how often. Everything except the service requirement is off until you set it.

setting.help: Continuous service required before an employee may borrow at all. 0 lets anyone apply.
How many loans one employee may have running at once. 0 means no limit.
Refuse a new application while the employee still owes anything on an earlier loan.
Days that must pass after settling a loan before the same employee may apply again. Counted from the last posted repayment.

block.title: How Much
block.help: The ceiling is a multiple of monthly basic salary that rises with length of service. The bands themselves are records, because how many bands you run is a policy choice.

setting.help: Each band applies from its year threshold upward. Below the lowest band nobody may borrow.
Measure the maximum against what the employee already owes plus the new request, rather than against the new request on its own.
What a loan is lent under, and how any interest is worked out.

block.title: Repayment
block.help: What comes out of a payslip, and when it starts.

setting.help: Fixed: a set figure each period. Percent: a share of the principal each period, so 10% repays in about ten periods. A loan product may override this.

How often an instalment falls due. Weekly/semi-monthly/monthly prorate by the days each payslip covers; Per Payslip (flat) takes the whole instalment out of every cutoff. A loan product may override this.
The payroll cutoff calendar Per Payslip (flat) loans follow: one instalment falls due each time a cutoff closes. Semi-monthly closes on the 15th and the last day of the month.
On a fixed basis. Offered on a new application and editable per loan.
On a percent basis. The share of the principal repaid each period; editable per loan.
Days between approval and the first deduction, so the employee has the proceeds before anything is taken back.
Cap on total loan repayments across every active loan, as a percentage of monthly basic salary. 0 means no limit.

block.title: Coverage
block.help: Who the loan policy applies to at all. Both off by default; a client turns on what their handbook says.

setting.help: Comma-separated: employee (regular), worker, student, trainee, contractor, freelance. Empty allows every type.
Employees under a manpower agency cannot apply themselves; an HR administrator must file the loan for them. Needs the agency field from hr_api_odoo.

block.title: External Borrowers
block.help: Loans to people who are not employees. Off by default; a lender to its own staff has no business accepting an application from a contact.

setting.help: A loan may be made to a contact. The service, salary and coverage rules do not apply; repayments are recorded by hand.
The only automatic limit, since there is no salary to measure against. 0 means no limit; use Advise mode and review by hand.
